item.artDescription: An engraving on this furniture represents a rectangle surrounded by circles. The style is pixelated with figurative elements. A meerkat fades in near the main subject.

This furniture is engraved with an artwork of a brightly-glowing spot falling to the ground in a cloud of ash. Hundreds of figures prepare tools and equipment. This illustration tells the story of a meteorite falling near Rissa's city on 4th of Jugust, 5456.
This furniture bears an image of a solitary trader moving to the left. The work symbolizes harmony.
This carving is shaped like an echidna wearing a belt riding on a goose wearing a duster. A tapir lies in the distance. The work conveys the emotions of distance.
This carving bears a portrayal of an empty tuque. The baroque style of the central scene clashes with the symbolic depiction of the background. The scene takes place in the middle of a city.

li.combatLogText: <color=#D09B61FF>Mushinto</color>'s bolt-action rifle bullet injured <color=#D09B61FF>the timber wolf</color>'s body.
<color=#D09B61FF>The timber wolf</color>'s front right leg was damaged by <color=#D09B61FF>Kalie</color>'s heavy SMG bullet.
<color=#D09B61FF>The timber wolf</color>'s rear left leg was wounded by <color=#D09B61FF>Mushinto</color>'s bolt-action rifle bullet.
<color=#D09B61FF>The timber wolf</color>'s body was damaged by <color=#D09B61FF>Mushinto</color>'s bolt-action rifle bullet.

item.artDescription: This furniture is engraved with an artwork of boxers playing poker. The work has a symbolic feeling and a static structure. Unusually for this kind of work, the scene takes place inside a town built near a swamp.

An engraving on this furniture shows Caldimenes 'Blackfury' Kyssius finishing a project with an indebted expression. The scene is surrounded by a thousand books. This illustration relates to Blackfury becoming a master at artistic tasks on 6th of Aprimay, 2519.

This furniture bears a depiction of ten historians and witch doctors eating yams together. There is a pack of pelicans off to one side. The work is infused with the idea of agony and is done in a cel-shaded style.
